entities.summary: Giovanni Andrea dell'Anguillara was an Italian poet. His verse translation of Ovid's Metamorphoses was often reprinted and has been highly praised by italian critics; a partial translation of Virgil's Aeneid enjoyed less success. Anguillara also wrote the comedy Anfitrione, and the tragedy Edippo, based on Seneca's Oedipus and on Sophocles' Oedipus Rex.
